<function name="GetColor" parent="DLabel" type="panelfunc">
	<description>
Returns the actual color of the text.

See also <page>DLabel:GetTextColor</page> and <page>DLabel:GetTextStyleColor</page>.
	</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="Color">The the actual <page>Color</page> of the text.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
